title: Dashboard: Practice Streaks Calendar
description: GitHub-style contribution heatmap for practice streaks. MOBILE-FIRST with scrollable calendar.

technicalContext.responsive: MOBILE-FIRST: Horizontally scrollable heatmap on mobile, full view on desktop
technicalContext.tailwind: Use Tailwind: overflow-x-auto, grid sizing, color intensity classes

acceptanceCriteria.text: Create Convex schema for userPracticeLog table
Create mutation to log practice session (called when user practices)
Create query to get practice history for last 90 days
Show current streak count prominently (e.g., '🔥 5 day streak!')
Display calendar heatmap (90 days, GitHub-style grid)
Color intensity based on practice amount that day
Tap/hover on day shows: date, practice time, lines practiced
MOBILE-FIRST: Horizontally scrollable heatmap on small screens
TAILWIND RESPONSIVE: Full heatmap visible on md+ breakpoints
UX: Touch-friendly day cells (min 24px), tooltip on tap for mobile
UI: Tailwind color scale (bg-green-100 to bg-green-900) for intensity
